ITEM 1 | Sliced cucumber-like rounds and half-moons, pale-to-medium green skin with lighter green flesh and pale seed centers, smooth moist surface with slight sheen, pieces roughly 1.5-2.5 cm thick and 4-6 cm long, arranged in a loose cluster on the left-center of the plate | 60

ITEM 2 | Browned meat chunks with dark brown to nearly black charred crusty edges and a slightly glossy surface, irregular cubes and chunks about 2-3 cm each, scattered on the right side of the plate near the sliced items | 60

ITEM 3 | Sliced pale golden-brown meat pieces with a seared outer surface and lighter cream interior, moist and fibrous looking, sliced into strips about 1 cm thick and 5-6 cm long, stacked slightly overlapping on the right edge of the plate | 70

ITEM 4 | Small dark brown crumbly bits and a few light specks scattered at the plate's right and lower-right area, dry looking with no visible sauce | 5
